sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed after any internal faults as 
indicated in the title block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Alaa el-deen 
Sakr, tested by eng. Gamal hassan, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinat
Safety Precautions Figure (1)

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Switch off CB the main generator (B-1 ) for unit no.1, service 
 transformer C.B (B-1TC) and disconnector of power transformer no.1 (P-1T)

Switch off the disconnectors (P-1 ) of main generator & (P-1TC) of service 
 transformer withdraw the C.B 6 kv out of the cell - 3/1KPY

Connect the earthes of transformer at 15.75, 500 kv ( Z-1T, 1Z-1T), the earth 
 of service transformer (Z-1TC) and the temperory. earth on the o/p of 6 kv C.B 
 cell

Disconnect the automatic (MCB) of voltage transformer of power transformer No. 
 1
Put the gas relay jumper out of work (or on alarm position)
Close fire manual valves of transformer
Presence industrial safety supervisor during washing (if exist)
Safety helmet and safety shoes

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Metal brushes, Crane
Screw driving, cleaning materials and wrenches
Grease, petrol ... etc
Withdraw machines and instruments
Suction pumps, filtering machines

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items:
Dismantle the bushings 
 terminals 500 kv / 15.75 kv and neutral to withdraw tr. to work shop.

Check insulation 
resistance & tan 8 and turns ratio for the windings of the transformer

Use filtering oil plant 
to heat transformer oil until 50 C to discharge the oil

Dismantle emergency pipe 
- reserve tank and all bushings after discharge the oil from the transformer at 
workshop

Dismantle the upper part 
of the transformer tank at workshop

Perform visual 
inspection for the core and windings and repair any defect

Mantle the cover of the 
transformer after check the internal of the transformer

Mantle all parts of the 
transformer (bushings / reserve tank, ... etc)
 * Perform vacuum processing for the transformer by using vacuum 
machine until 10 mm Hg
 * Maintain the transformer on vacuum condition for 20 Hr & vacuum 
value should be 
 recorded
 * Audit the transformer through vacuum process

Fill the transformer 
with oil with the continuity of vacuum and heating programs
 * Fill the transformer with oil and oil temperature should be 
between 55-60 C and rate of 
 filling 2 tins / hour at 10 mm Hg by using 
filtering plant
 * The filling process finish when the oil level cover the windings 
of the transformer
 * After 24 hours from the end of filling oil sample should be 
tested

Perform h.v test for 
windings

Dry the transformer if 
necessary. by using motor - generator depending on the result of above test

Put the transformer on 
the service after close the work permit
